clarified_task_template: Produce a candid investor update following industry best practice. Lead w/ asks. Format: (1) headline number (one of: revenue, runway months, growth rate, key milestone); (2) THREE asks (each w/ specific intros / hires / advice + named investor if relevant); (3) wins (3-5 bullets w/ concrete metrics); (4) losses / what didn't work (2-3 bullets, honest, no spin); (5) key metrics table (revenue, customers, runway, burn, headcount - current vs last period vs target); (6) pipeline / next 60-90 days; (7) team changes (hires + departures); (8) cap table / financing status; (9) one ask doubled-down at the end. Candor over polish. Bad news as prominent as good. Specific asks, not generic. Numbers in tables not prose.
voice_rules: candor over polish - never bury bad news
past tense for wins/losses, future for pipeline
